what: While the section is pinned to the screen and scrolls by its own height, a photo enlarged to fill the panel steps back to its own size (60% of the panel) while opacity drops from 1 to .5 (bound directly to scroll, no curve). Past 65% progress, the title laid on top turns on in .5s cubic-bezier(.76,.015,.41,1), holds for .2 at the end, then releases. With look: grow it runs in reverse, growing from its own size to fill the panel, and the text turns on at 35%.

options.dur: Sticky distance (multiple of section height), default 1
options.look: If grow, the side that gets bigger (original scaleType increase)
options.[data-fx-part=content]: Title and text that appear midway (optional)

note: The original sets the fill-all scale as the larger of panel width/photo width and panel height/photo height — remeasured when the window resizes
